[app/page.tsx](/vercel/sandbox/app/page.tsx) now renders that component inside `<Suspense>`, so the timestamp changes on every page load. I also updated the page metadata in [app/layout.tsx](/vercel/sandbox/app/layout.tsx).

`npm run build` passes, and the build output marks `/` as `ƒ` (dynamic), confirming it is not prerendered at build time. The build also auto-generated `next-env.d.ts` and updated [tsconfig.json](/vercel/sandbox/tsconfig.json) to Next’s preferred TypeScript settings.
